'''Hecaya's Might''' was an anarchist group that was captured by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the later years of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and imprisoned in the [[Belsavis prison|prison complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The remaining members, a trio of [[Human/Legends|Humans]], were incarcerated in the [[Minimum Security Section]] of the [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hecaya's Might group first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' on the planet Belsavis, as a group of unidentified background non-player characters.<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> However, the [[2012]] reference guide ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' featured them in a picture and a caption in the "A New Population of Scum and Villainy" infobox in the section on Belsavis.<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
